| Diagnosis | `PromptShimTools.BuildParameterValuesAsync` (`src/RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio/Tools/PromptShimTools.cs:112-198`) is declared `async Task<object?[]>` but its only await is `Task.CompletedTask.ConfigureAwait(false)` at line 115 — a no-op that makes the whole binder needlessly async while packing JSON parsing, object-kind validation, a 4-clause LINQ missing-required-parameter scan, and a per-parameter resolution loop (cancellation-token short-circuit, DI service resolution, JSON-present deserialize, default-value fallback, required-but-missing throw) into one method. | Approach | In `src/RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio/Tools/PromptShimTools.cs`: (1) rename/convert `BuildParameterValuesAsync` to synchronous `private static object?[] BuildParameterValues(MethodInfo method, IServiceProvider services, string parametersJson, CancellationToken ct)` — drop the `Task.CompletedTask` no-op and the `async`/`await`/`ConfigureAwait` plumbing entirely; update the sole caller at line 44 (`GetPromptText`) to `var parameterValues = BuildParameterValues(method, services, parametersJson, ct);` (drop `await`/`.ConfigureAwait(false)`). ### 3. client-root-path-validator-complexity-extraction

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Diagnosis | `IsPathUnderAnyRoot` in `src/RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio/Tools/ClientRootPathValidator.cs:119-163` measures cyclomatic complexity ~11 (Evidence: read-side Roslyn metrics, 2026-07-17). The method interleaves three distinct concerns in one body: (1) eager materialization of the allowed-root set into a `List<string>` sized `rootPaths.Count * (expandSanctionedRoots ? 2 : 1)` (line 126), (2) the one-level parent-widening branch with drive-root exclusion (lines 131-143), and (3) the separator-bounded exact/child/case-insensitive comparison loop (lines 146-160). Manually walking the branches (`rootPaths.Count == 0` check, outer `foreach`, `expandSanctionedRoots` gate, the `&&`-joined widening guard, inner `foreach`, `Equals` check, ternary normalization, `StartsWith` check) accounts for the CC-11 reading. Folding root-set *construction* and root-set *matching* into a single function is the direct cause. |
| Approach | Extract three private static helpers within the same file (no new file, no signature change on the public entry point): (a) `EnumerateAllowedRoots(IReadOnlyList<string> rootPaths, bool expandSanctionedRoots)` — an `IEnumerable<string>` iterator (`yield return`) that replaces the eager `List<string> allowedRoots` materialization at line 126, directly satisfying the acceptance criterion "adds no root-list materialization"; (b) `GetWidenedParent(string rootPath)` — isolates the one-level parent-widening + drive-root-exclusion logic currently at lines 138-141, returning `string?`; (c) `IsPathUnderRoot(string fullPath, string rootPath)` — isolates the exact-match / separator-bounded-child-match / case-insensitive comparison currently at lines 148-159. `IsPathUnderAnyRoot` becomes a thin driver: keep the `rootPaths.Count == 0` fast-path, then `foreach (var rootPath in EnumerateAllowedRoots(rootPaths, expandSanctionedRoots)) { if (IsPathUnderRoot(fullPath, rootPath)) return true; } return false;`. Each extracted helper's own CC is ≤4 by hand-count, and the driver's CC drops to ~4 — both comfortably under the acceptance target of ≤8. The public signature of `IsPathUnderAnyRoot(string, IReadOnlyList<string>, bool)` is unchanged, so the sole production caller (`ValidatePathAgainstRootsAsync` at line 72, same file) and all 12 `mcp__roslyn__symbol_search` hits for `IsPathUnderAnyRoot` (1 definition + 11 existing test methods in `tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/ClientRootPathValidatorTests.cs`) require zero changes — they exercise the method black-box and continue to pass as the regression net. No filesystem I/O is introduced (matches acceptance criterion 4); `ResolvePath` (lines 168-217) is out of scope for this initiative (tracked separately by the dependent backlog row `client-root-path-validator-remaining-complexity`, deps-gated on this one). |
| Scope | Production files (1): `src/RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio/Tools/ClientRootPathValidator.cs`. Test files added/modified (0): the 11 existing `IsPathUnderAnyRoot_*` tests in `tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/ClientRootPathValidatorTests.cs` already cover exact-path, path-equal-to-root, sibling-rejected-without-flag, sibling-allowed-with-flag, worktree-subdir-allowed, grandparent-rejected-even-with-flag, drive-root-never-widens, trailing-slash-normalized, prefix-trap-rejected, empty-roots-rejects, and case-insensitive-on-Windows — this is the full acceptance-criteria surface (exact-path, separator-bounded child, case-insensitive, trailing-separator, one-level-only widening, sibling/prefix-trap/grandparent/drive-root rejection) and needs no new cases since the public contract is unchanged. No files deleted. Well within Rule 3 (≤4 production files) and Rule 4 (≤3 test files) — no exemption needed. |
| Tool policy | edit-only — single-file, textual/local method-extraction diff; no rename, no cross-project symbol change, no solution-wide refactor. |
| Estimated context cost | 38000 |
| Risks | (1) Behavior-preservation risk: the widening/matching logic has subtle edge cases (drive-root exclusion, trailing-separator normalization, prefix-trap rejection) already pinned by the 11 existing tests — run them post-refactor as the primary safety net rather than relying on visual diff review. (2) Iterator laziness: `EnumerateAllowedRoots` must be enumerated exactly once per `IsPathUnderAnyRoot` call (it already is, via the single `foreach`) — a future caller that enumerates it twice would silently re-run `Path.GetDirectoryName`/`Path.GetPathRoot` per pass; harmless today given the sole call site but worth a one-line XML-doc note. Re-measure cyclomatic complexity on `IsPathUnderAnyRoot` and the three new helpers (via the same read-side Roslyn metrics tooling cited in Evidence, or manual branch-count) to confirm each is ≤8 per the acceptance criterion. |

### 4. compositeapply-temp-cleanup-failure-observability

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Diagnosis | `AtomicFileWriter.TryDeleteTemp` (`src/RoslynMcp.Roslyn/Services/CompositeApplyOrchestrator.cs:145-158`) catches `IOException`/`UnauthorizedAccessException` on the stray `.tmp` delete and discards it with only a code comment — "Best-effort cleanup — a stray .tmp is non-fatal and must not mask the original failure." No bundle candidates were supplied for this row. |

No changes to `CompileCheckService.cs` / `CompileCheckOptions.cs` — the truncation is entirely a function of the `Limit` the CALLER requests, and only this one caller's request changes. |

| Approach | Single-file decomposition of `ToolErrorHandler.cs`, no new files. (1) Extract the reload-race guard (lines 279-288) into `private static bool TryClassifyReloadRace(Exception ex, out ErrorInfo info)` — same 4-condition test, same message, same exclusion of `WorkspaceEvictedException`. (2) Extract the `_errorHandlers` dictionary walk (lines 291-295) into `private static bool TryClassifyRegisteredHandler(Exception ex, string toolName, out ErrorInfo info)` — identical `foreach`/`IsAssignableFrom` walk, preserving dictionary insertion order (the existing class already documents order-dependent precedence at lines 22-33, e.g. `WorkspaceEvictedException` registered before the base `KeyNotFoundException` entry — this ordering constraint carries over unchanged since the dictionary itself is not touched).
